# Job Hound preset instructions

Read and follow `/AGENTS.md` and `/CONTRIBUTING.md` before editing this
repository. The normalized catalog-version-3 source files are authoritative.
Do not create or edit legacy monolithic presets, root catalogs, or generated
API, search, bundle, and distribution artifacts. A scraper is not verified
until it has passed a fresh run through the real JobHound runtime with evidence
of company ownership and no cross-company contamination.
